cases.scope: Retail entry instructions execute in the SH-4 subset interpreter; callees use explicit stubs. This verifies branch/call order and semaphore release, not callee behavior.

cases.name: positive result with cleanup flag
cases.scope: Retail entry instructions execute in the SH-4 subset interpreter; callees use explicit stubs. This verifies branch/call order and semaphore release, not callee behavior.

limitations: This is control-path evidence only; the service, record writer, fatal reporter, and cleanup callee are not executed by this test.
The cleanup routine 0x8c646654 remains the main unresolved dependency for complete behavior verification.
